source: Hand-written with Ahsan, 2026-10-29, from the projects list on https://www.byahsan.com (src/pages/index.astro and src/data/projects/*.json in byahsan-live). The chapters around the n-of-1 chapter, in page order: the lab, the bedside. The patent sentence is his wording, word for word; the WakeLight facts, including waking in light sleep, are as he states them. *Protocols* is Huberman's Protocols: An Operating Manual for the Human Body, title confirmed on hubermanlab.com/protocols-book (2026-10-29); no lux figure is taken from it. The lab diagram's first lane is redrawn from byahsan-live/public/project-media/delphi-sketch.svg.

steps.label: In the lab
steps.line: A cancer diagnostics lab, running itself
text: I wrote the lab's tools, and I built an AI that scores breast cancer slides after chemo. Provisional patent filed 2026, in collaboration with MD Anderson Cancer Center.

steps.label: At the bedside
text: My Philips wake-up light gave a few hundred lux, so I built a travel lamp that costs under $20 to make and follows the morning-light protocol in Andrew Huberman's book *Protocols*. It moves with organic, cartoon-like motion so it feels like part of the room.
